title: Genome-Wide CRISPR Screen Identifies a microRNA Orchestrating Pleiotropic Resistance to Targeted Therapy and T Cell Immunity in Melanoma
barcs_calls: 441 miRNAs at FDR 0.10 with median-ratio totals
verdict: BARCS recovers miR-18a as the second strongest enriched miRNA, but only after median-ratio normalization; with library totals the composition shift buries it at rank 1,415.
